race.comment: I SEA RED (2) has had two runs this campaign and is yet to finish in the top three. Added to the sequence last time over 1609m at Cranbourne, finishing 9 metres away from the winner in fifth. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Meets a comparable field and he can make sharp improvement. AMALFI NZ (4) finished seventh first-up last time out when he broke in a 2195m event at Ararat two weeks ago. Only needs to get things right to be in contention. KEAYANG SANTIAGO (3) is worth another chance after a last-start eighth over 1690m at Shepparton six days ago. STORMS (6) disappointed last time but is a chance based on a good win over 2150m at St Arnaud two runs back.
